findings.issue_category: missing key rotation and overly permissive default policy
findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is not set to true), which weakens cryptographic hygiene over time. Additionally, no policy is defined for the key, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy which grants full access (kms:*) to the entire AWS account via IAM, potentially allowing any IAM principal with permissive IAM policies to manage or use this key for audit trail data.
